title: OpenSpec – A lightweight and configurable AI spec framework
summary: OpenSpec is a lightweight and configurable AI specification framework designed to help developers create, manage, and process AI-related specifications with flexibility and ease of use.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of managing complex AI specifications and configurations without the overhead of heavyweight frameworks.
why_valuable: Provides developers with a minimal, adaptable tool that can be customized for various AI workflows while maintaining simplicity and performance.
